changes.title: Witnesses of Six Flags roller coaster death speak on incident
changes.summary: Six Flags announced that multiple thrill rides across the country will be shut down temporarily after a 42-year-old father died on Monday on a roller coaster in Georgia. Skyler Henry reports on the victim and what may have gone wrong.

changes.title: News Wrap: Cornell bans fraternity parties for rest of academic year
changes.summary: In our news wrap Tuesday, Cornell University is banning parties and other social events at fraternities for the rest of the academic year, a man fell to his death while riding a roller coaster at a Six Flags amusement park outside Atlanta, the Supreme Court will hear a case over access to DOGE records and a bipartisan.
